notes.title: ✨ The Empty Desk now fully voiced in Italian – thanks to an incredible team!
notes.notes: [p]When I first started working on [i]The Empty Desk[/i], I poured all my energy, time, and savings into creating a story-driven experience that would stay with players long after the credits rolled. As a solo developer with limited resources, my goal was always to deliver the highest possible quality. But reality hit hard—after spending all I had on development, I simply didn’t have the budget for professional voice acting.[/p][p]To offer an alternative for players who prefer listening to reading, I added AI-generated voices as a temporary solution. Some players appreciated this effort, but many—especially in certain languages—felt it hurt the immersion and emotional weight of the story. I listened to this feedback and made the tough decision to remove most of the voice-overs, leaving only the written dialogue to preserve the narrative experience.[/p][p]Then something amazing happened.[/p][p]Daniele Bosi, who runs a fantastic YouTube channel (RedFlameFox), reached out to me. He told me how much he loved [i]The Empty Desk[/i] and how he wished it could be fully voiced in Italian. What started as a simple conversation turned into something extraordinary. Daniele, completely out of passion for the project and without asking for anything in return, took it upon himself to organize and direct a team of talented Italian voice actors. Together, they breathed life into every character, every emotional beat, every whispered secret of the game.[/p][p]Thanks to their incredible effort and dedication, [i]The Empty Desk[/i] now has a [b]full professional Italian voice-over[/b]—and honestly, it has become my favorite version of the game. Hearing Detective Bennett’s story told with such emotion and care by real professionals is beyond anything I imagined when I started this journey.[/p][p]I cannot thank Daniele and his team enough for their passion, talent, and generosity. If you ever need Italian localization or voice work, I recommend them 100%. And if one day [i]The Empty Desk[/i] becomes successful enough to fund Detective Bennett’s next case, they will absolutely be my first choice to bring it to life.[/p][p]Here’s the amazing Italian team who made this dream possible: 🎤 [b]Daniele Bosi (RedFlameFox)[/b] – Voice director, translator, dialogue adaptation 🕵️‍♂️ [b]Daniele Morchio[/b] – Voice of Bennett 👻 [b]Jessica Tedesco[/b] – Voice of Emily / Ghost 📖 [b]Antonella De Stefano (AntaDest)[/b] – Voice of Sarah 🔍 [b]Samuele Ricci (SamDub)[/b] – Voice of Arthur 📚 [b]Luca Costantini[/b] – Voice of Harold 💼 [b]Alessandra Guerra[/b] – Voice of Margaret 🎧 [b]Simone Erik Turco (ilsimo2000)[/b] – Voice of Oliver, sound assistant[/p][p]Grazie mille to the whole team. Your passion made this possible. ❤️[/p]

notes.title: 40% OFF – A Summer Deal From a Story-Driven Heart
notes.notes: [p]As a gamer myself, I know how important Steam Sales are. They’re not just discounts — they’re the moment many of us wait for to finally grab that game we’ve been watching.[/p][p]That’s why I’m offering [i]The Empty Desk[/i] at [b]40% off[/b] — the biggest discount I’ve ever done. I want to make it easier for anyone who's been curious to finally step into the world of Detective Bennett.[/p][p]This isn’t just a game I made — it’s a story I [i]needed[/i] to tell. A slow-burning thriller, filled with emotion, mystery, and personal touches I poured into every scene. If you enjoy narrative games with atmosphere and tension, I truly believe you’ll connect with this one.[/p][p]As a solo dev with no big studio behind me, your support means the world. Every copy sold brings me one step closer to developing Bennett’s next case — and many more stories I can’t wait to share.[/p][p]Thank you for reading, thank you for playing, and thank you for supporting indie games. Let the Summer Sale begin![/p][p]– Joaquín Developer of [i]The Empty Desk[/i][/p]

notes.title: Adjusted object scales and other details
notes.notes:
I have corrected the scale of certain objects that were not properly proportioned to the protagonist.

Additionally, starting from this version, the game will launch without English and German voices by default. This is because some players are sensitive to AI-generated voices, which can affect their immersion or interest in the story. Out of respect for this part of the audience, I have set only sound effects as the default option.

For those who enjoy the voices, don’t worry! You can still enable them anytime in the game settings.

Thanks to everyone for your feedback—every bit helps make the game better!

notes.title: PLAY YOUR WAY!
notes.notes:
Throughout the chapters, there are certain moments where unexpected scares may appear.

You can play with the scares enabled or without them—it's your choice. If you enjoy the thrill of the unexpected, keep them on. But if you don't like jump scares and prefer to focus on the story, you can disable them for a more immersive experience.

notes.title: Still Working Full Speed on The Empty Desk!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

I wanted to share that the development of The Empty Desk is moving full steam ahead. I’ve had the chance to watch several streamers play the demo, and that’s given me incredibly useful firsthand feedback to polish many details that weren’t entirely clear.

I listen to every comment you send my way. I take note of everything you share because your feedback is key to improving the game experience.

Good News About the Character Art!
Thanks to your feedback, I’ve decided to update the character art. Many of you mentioned that the realistic style made the characters look a bit dull and lifeless, so… I’ve given it a fresh twist!

Now, while the game maintains its realistic first-person aesthetic, during narrative scenes you’ll see the characters with a more adventurous style, designed to look like detailed hand-drawn illustrations that capture each character’s spirit. They’re more visible, with an aesthetic that adds a fresh, vibrant touch, helping you immerse yourself in the story in a more engaging and enjoyable way.

Your Suggestions Matter!
I’m continuing to implement improvements based on your feedback, so don’t hesitate to let me know what you’d like to see improved in the demo.

Thank you for all your support and feedback. I’m still working with great enthusiasm and… with more mystery on the horizon! ;)

Joaquin

notes.title: The Empty Desk: A True Crime Mystery in the Dark
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45277902/e3412c7c3edc0128083208107d8fc3105eb85c02.png[/img]

📢 Welcome to The Empty Desk!

Hey everyone!

I’m super excited to finally introduce The Empty Desk, my passion project and my first solo game here on Steam. This is my very first post, and I couldn’t wait to share a little about what I’m working on and what’s coming up soon.

[b]What is The Empty Desk?[/b]
The Empty Desk is a mystery exploration game where you’ll be uncovering secrets behind an abandoned desk with a hidden story. As you dig deeper, you’ll realize there’s a lot more going on beneath the surface. I’ve been pouring my heart into creating a unique atmosphere that’s full of tension, mystery, and suspense—I hope it’ll keep you at the edge of your seat!

[b]I’m hard at work on the demo[/b]
I know that seeing is believing—and playing is even better! Right now, I’m putting all my energy into finishing a playable demo so you can experience a slice of The Empty Desk firsthand. I don’t have an exact release date yet, but I’m aiming to have it ready very soon.

[b]Add The Empty Desk to your wishlist![/b]
If you’re interested and want to be the first to know when the demo drops or when I post new updates, please consider adding The Empty Desk to your wishlist. Every wishlist really helps me out as a solo dev, and you’ll get notified whenever there’s news.

Thank you so much for being here and checking out my project. I can’t wait to share more with you soon!

🖤 Thanks for your support

Joaquin
